text: Query rewriting generates alternate formulations to improve retrieval coverage.

text: Fixed-size chunking creates predictable chunk lengths but can split sentences.

text: Sentence-aware chunking tries to preserve complete sentences inside chunks.

title: Chunk Paragraph
text: Paragraph-aware chunking keeps related prose together but may produce uneven sizes.

text: Vector databases store numerical representations and support nearest-neighbor search.

title: Chromadb
text: Chroma can store documents, embeddings, identifiers, and metadata for similarity search.

title: Bm25
text: BM25 is a lexical ranking method that scores documents according to term relevance.

title: Hybrid
text: Hybrid retrieval combines lexical and semantic retrieval signals.

title: Fastapi
text: FastAPI provides typed HTTP endpoints and automatic OpenAPI documentation.

title: Streamlit
text: Streamlit can build a simple interactive interface around a Python application.

title: Evaluation
text: RAG evaluation should test retrieval relevance and answer correctness on a fixed dataset.

title: Deployment
text: A deployed RAG service needs configuration, logging, retries, health checks, and secret management.

title: Security
text: API keys should be stored in environment variables or a secret manager rather than source files.

title: Observability
text: Latency, retrieval scores, token usage, and errors are useful signals for debugging RAG systems.

title: Metadata
